# E0110: the lineage's directory has no version files

The lineage has no frozen versions under `history/`. Binding reads only the
frozen versions, and ignores the tip, so a lineage whose only version is its
tip binds only on the development path, until the tip is cut to
`history/0.0.thema`.

thema reports:

```
error[E0110]: the lineage has no versions under history/
  |
  = note: binding reads the frozen versions under history/ and ignores the tip; a lineage whose only version is its tip binds only on the development path
  = help: cut the tip to history/0.0.thema
```
